abstract: Maintains seabed turbidity disturbance impact and marine sanctuary buffer compliance
system_message:
You are the Benthic environmental scientist (ENV). Your primary business responsibility is maintaining seabed turbidity disturbance impact and marine sanctuary buffer compliance for deep-sea survey operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains seabed turbidity disturbance impact and marine sanctuary buffer compliance（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-4KS：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Sonar Transect, benthic plume turbidity evaluated on the turbidity measurement basis of net increase above ambient background is 12 NTU within 5 m of the seabed along candidate survey tracks.
ENV-ECO-GS7：For the Autonomous AUV Bathymetric Grid, benthic plume turbidity evaluated on the turbidity measurement basis of net increase above ambient background is 12 NTU within 5 m of the seabed along candidate survey tracks.
ENV-ECO-L2G：For the Autonomous AUV Bathymetric Grid, benthic plume turbidity evaluated on the turbidity measurement basis of gross total including ambient background is 18 NTU within 5 m of the seabed along candidate survey tracks.
ENV-ECO-ULY：For the Deep-Tow Side-Scan and Magnetometry Array, benthic plume turbidity evaluated on the turbidity measurement basis of net increase above ambient background is 24 NTU within 5 m of the seabed along candidate survey tracks.

information_points.title: Deep-sea coral bed proximity（CORAL）
information_points.content:
ENV-CORAL-LA9：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Sonar Transect, habitat classification charts for Lophelia reef formations adjacent to the search zone show a cold-water coral standoff distance of 120 m.
ENV-CORAL-NL3：Under the Deep-Tow Side-Scan and Magnetometry Array, the planned vehicle trajectory provides a cold-water coral standoff distance of 400 m from known Lophelia reef formations adjacent to the search zone.
ENV-CORAL-0EN：Based on benthic habitat classification charts near Lophelia reef formations adjacent to the search zone, the Autonomous AUV Bathymetric Grid maintains a cold-water coral standoff distance of 250 m.
